source_en: A new face at the gate. Givi Jashi, postman for the whole valley.
Your paper's in the box. Party bulletins and bread prices, mostly.
Real news doesn't get past the censor. Read between the lines.
Fewer every week. Most use it to light the stove.
I've walked this route since '71. Every door, every dog that hates me.
The smog doesn't read addresses. I do.
I know their mail. That's knowing them better than they'd like.
Same time tomorrow, Officer. The mail doesn't wait.
